text: B4 synthetic decomposition runner is cross-platform green at the contract level. JVM four-test suite passes 4/4; Scala.js native matrix suite passes 3/3 in 591s, and the isolated exact-oracle 12 mm control passes 1/1 on JVM (10s) and Scala.js (96s). Native bridge-to-fine captures 2/4/8 mm; 12 mm bridge is exact (pre p95 12 mm, post p95 0 mm, true-CC loss 0.01752563304620694, rematched) but the frozen fine stage is retained as HalfFlowCcError.RegriddedTopologyInvalid with minimum accumulated Jacobian 0.028076171875. Exact 12 mm oracle bridge succeeds and oracle-plus-fine reproduces the same rejection, localizing the current limit away from block confidence. Receipt: docs/benchmarks/receipts/basinbridge-b4-decomposition-2026-08-02.json. Production budget2x/full oracle matrix, runtime/allocation/memory serialization, same-affine sub18, and five-pair external validation remain pending.
